newsitem.title: GERMANY: Siemens has 140 mln DM German tram order.
newsitem.headline: Siemens has 140 mln DM German tram order.

text.p: Siemens AG's transport equipment division said on Friday it had won a 140 million mark ($89.9 million) order to supply 48 low-floor tram wagons to the eastern German city of Potsdam.
The order is the first for Siemens' new "Combino" tramcar and first deliveries are planned in autumn 1998, Siemens said in a statement. The contract will be completed in 2009.
Combino streetcars have entrances which are just 30 cm (12 inches) above street level, making it easier for passengers to get on and off. ($ = 1.557 German Marks)
